verdict.rationale: Crossplane's own Composite Resource Definitions "define schemas for composite resources" (crossplane-docs-13), and the vendor describes its declarative APIs as "machine-readable" (crossplane-docs-29, crossplane-gh-1). That is a first-party schema capability, but the pack never says these schemas are OpenAPI or downloadable, so support is thin. Missing for 10: any documented way to download or export a machine-readable spec (OpenAPI or equivalent), explicit confirmation of the spec format, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
